conditionReports.title: Hallandsleden
conditionReports.relevance: High: direct first-person field report for stage 3, Äskhults by to Stättared, after the 2024 reroute.
observations: Initial part after Äskhult used gravel and asphalt roads except near Axtorps gamla tomt.
Route passed a stable and horse paddocks, then climbed a steep hill.
Middle part used smaller paths through mixed forest/terrain, blueberry-rich and mossy forest, stone walls, boardwalks and forest paths.
Before Idala there was a long downhill and then gravel road through fields and farms.
Final kilometres included a hilly powerline corridor before the Stora Hornsjön/Stättared approach.
Shelter visible at the Stättared endpoint; no closure or impassable obstacle reported.
importImplications: Good source for descriptive app copy and red-difficulty support.
Do not derive coordinates from report.
